column5: When you cast a Psijic Order ability while you are in combat, you generate a spell charge for 10 seconds. When you reach 5 spell charges, you launch a spell orb at the closest enemy to you dealing 1537 Magic Damage . This effect scales off your highest offensive stats.

column5: While you have a Psijic Order ability slotted and are Bracing, you gain a damage shield that absorbs 2500 damage. This damage shield recharges back to full strength after you spend 10 seconds not Bracing.

Skill Rank: While you have a Psijic Order ability slotted and are Bracing, you gain a damage shield that absorbs 5000 damage. This damage shield recharges back to full strength after you spend 10 seconds not Bracing.

column5: While you are casting or channeling a Psijic Order ability you reduce your damage taken by 30 %.
